description:
The boundary the petitioners propose for the Hickory Sands District AVA (Docket No. TTB-2026-0005, Notice No. 243, 91 FR 52576), with the changes discussed with TTB on October 15, 2026. Prepared by Dan McLaughlin, Robert Clay Vineyards (petitioner).

Start here: 0 Dashboard (the map, every step, every difference and a link to every file) and 0 Read me first (what each item is, and the license).

Browse the content by category (like folders):

  1. Boundary description (proposed text)
  2. Notice No. 243 - proposed changes highlighted
  3. Changes side by side
  4. GIS data: map and layers; downloads (GeoPackage, shapefiles, GeoJSON)
  5. USGS quadrangles with the boundary: GeoPDF and GeoTIFF
